title: Resolution urging Albany to count severe voluntary intoxication as lack of consent
summary: This resolution calls on the state legislature to pass, and the governor to sign, S.10632/A.101 to amend the Penal Law so that a victim's severe intoxication can establish lack of consent in sex crimes, even if the victim voluntarily consumed drugs or alcohol, as long as the defendant knew or should have known of their condition. It cites a September 2026 case involving allegations at a Cornell fraternity house as prompting renewed scrutiny of the law. The resolution notes that other states, including Minnesota, Michigan and Texas, have already changed similar laws.
